mission_09: Aggregation features summarize group-level statistics from granular data. In this mission, you will transform transaction-level data into customer-level features by computing aggregations like mean spend, total spend, transaction count, and spend variability. You will also derive temporal features like customer tenure and transaction frequency. This pattern of aggregating granular data to entity-level features is fundamental in feature engineering for customer analytics, fraud detection, and any domain where you have one-to-many relationships.
